Title: Insights and workbooks for Azure Cosmos DB now in general availability

Body.Content:
With the new Azure Monitor insights and Azure Monitor workbooks features, you can quickly access insights on usage and dynamically monitor your Azure Cosmos DB resources. Workbooks are a flexible platform for data analysis and visualizations that allows cross-referencing multiple sources including logs, metrics, alerts, resource health, and more to provide a comprehensive view of your Azure Cosmos DB environment. Insights is a ready-to-use pre-defined experience featuring the most sought-after analytics for monitoring your Azure Cosmos DB environment including throughput, request details, storage, availability, latency, and more.

Learn more about Azure Monitor insights and Azure Monitor workbooks.
